snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Ruler of the Skies | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Be on the lookout—Mega Rayquaza begins its descent in the upcoming Pokémon TCG Pocket expansion, Ruler of the Skies! 

This newest set features the debut of the Mega-Evolved Sky High Pokémon, loads of other cool Pokémon, and even more awesome cards and accessories! Available July 29 💫 

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
